title: Minecraft Pig
blurb: The Minecraft pig oink — a short, slightly deflated grunt that millions of players associate with either farming or immediate betrayal, depending on whether they had a saddle. Mojang's animal sounds are deliberately low-fidelity, matching the blocky visuals rather than reaching for realism, and that restraint is why they're so recognisable. Play it for barnyard edits, unexpected companions, and any moment involving a creature that trusted you shortly before it shouldn't have. Instantly identifiable to anyone who has ever built a fence.
origin: The pig mob sound from Minecraft (Mojang).
